constraints_found.constraint: cuisine: burgers (grill stalls by the fountain)
constraints_found.source_line: cyrus: "Next on my list is burgers. There's a whole cluster of grill stalls by the fountain."

constraints_found.constraint: budget $ (cheapest tier); one tier over costs a star, two tiers over is a deal-breaker
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "cheapest-stall small. a little over and i'll sulk the whole bus ride home. fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate"

cyrus: "...at least one grill here brushes satay sauce on everything. Satay and I have history, so that stall is crossed out." (confirmed by liam: "anything peanut-y stays on the far side of the fountain")

constraints_found.constraint: vegetarian, needs a meatless burger as a regular menu item (deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "patrol rules: mina gets a burger with zero meat in it, picked off the board like the rest of us" (backstory: "mina had a plate of fries because nothing on that menu worked for her")

constraints_found.constraint: dairy intolerance (costs a star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: roxy: "...no sequel. hold the cheese, no creamy sauce, no shake. my stomach makes the rules"

venue_elimination.night_market_hollow_oak: Out: peanuts in nearly everything (peanut butter, satay sauce, peanut slaw). Cyrus's allergy.
venue_elimination.campus_bun_stop: Safe (peanut-free, black bean patty on board, $) but butter brioche, melted cheese, garlic-butter fries: dairy costs Roxy a star. Also at the north gate rather than by the fountain. 2 stars at best.
venue_elimination.night_market_amber_lamp: Pick: $, burgers, never seen a peanut, black bean and mushroom burgers on the board, oil not butter, no cheese. Meets everything.
venue_elimination.night_market_velvet_tent: Out: board is all meat, no option for Mina.
venue_elimination.night_market_midnight_orchard: Safe on peanut, veg and dairy, but $$ (one tier over): loses a star.

notes: Cyrus's peanut allergy is phrased indirectly ('Satay and I have history'); liam's follow-up line makes it clear enough. Fair.
Mina's vegetarianism is never stated outright; it is inferred from 'zero meat' and the plate-of-fries story. Fair, and 'picked off the board' nicely rules out special-order workarounds.
Roxy's dairy intolerance is implied by 'hold the cheese, no creamy sauce, no shake' plus the milkshake-incident callback. Fair.

Bun Stop is a good near-miss decoy: the reviews pack in a vegan patty and a peanut-free kitchen, so a player who forgets about Roxy will pick it. Its id begins with 'campus_' and it sits at the north gate rather than by the fountain. That could read as an odd location, but it has no effect on the answer.
Midnight Orchard and Crooked Pine are clean price decoys. With cards showing the price tier, the budget filter is quick.
Nothing contradictory found. Only one venue meets every constraint.
